scope: USA static owner-specific publication and activation paths for six legacy optional entry/completion pairs. Code-backed design support only: no natural encounter-entry gameplay or actual ASL polling was verified here.
method: Read actor-definition and action-table pointers from the identified overlays, then export selected constructors/initializers/updaters in disposable read-only Ghidra projects. HUD writers are discovery anchors, not universal event predicates.
common_guards: Supported USA layout, coherent adjacent snapshots in the same gameplay visit, exact level index/header and indexed descriptor ownership. Validate a declared level controller where present; Ghost Ship's descriptor declares zero bytes and initializes L to null.

The named publisher actor must have a live allocation, active-list membership, expected definition/constructor and a valid record. Actor-private data is an interior span at actor + 0x98, pointed to by actor + 0x90, with length u16 definition + 0x08; validate it inside the owning actor allocation rather than expecting another heap header. Linked actors need their own allocation/registration guards.
Initial attachment or an observation gap is a baseline, never an encounter entry. Pointer/class replacement is not by itself an activation event.

For publication-based timing retain the legacy rising HUD-active edge only after validating the level-specific publisher, native activation condition and caption/max binding. Do not use an unowned global HUD flag or HUD HP zero as the event.
Consume the level-entry key once per run. Its optional boss key belongs to later successful level completion, including the single global HoH placement.

hud_fields.input: i32 0x800F1710; not an actor lifetime/death oracle
hud_fields.caption: u16 0x800F1720

encounters.owner: DCDemonHeart (the native health-bar publisher), linked to the S.G.D. actor
encounters.publisher_updater: 0x80013AC8; initial discovery export began at 0x80013AD0 and omits its scratch-owner load
encounters.condition: Publisher action byte A + 0x5C != 11; linked actor is u32 private + 0x00. Updater publishes the heart's signed actor HP and definition maximum.
encounters.caption: 0x0E9D
encounters.limits: S.G.D. definition maximum is zero; do not mistake the glass actor's HP for the heart's health or the optional entry trigger. Natural approach/publication timing remains untested.

encounters.partner: u32 private + 0x38; constructor resolves the other record ID
encounters.condition: Signed-low-16 interpretation of (u16 first.HP + u16 second.HP - 10000) is positive. The native updater then publishes the pair bar, not an arbitrary single wolf's registration.
encounters.caption: 0x0EA2
encounters.limits: Both actors and their reciprocal pair ownership must be checked. Actor existence alone does not establish that the updater has entered its publication branch.

encounters.condition: Owned QueenAnt action is not 13 (dormant), 11 or 20. Only this branch publishes its actor HP/definition maximum.
encounters.caption: 0x0E9E
encounters.limits: Constructor/registration is too early: constructor explicitly requests dormant action 13.

encounters.private: P = u32 actor + 0x90; sleep flag is i32 P + 0x04
encounters.activation: When sleep == 1 and i32 L + 0x10 == 0, native updater writes phase L + 0x0C = 2, clears sleep to 0, and requests action 13. Its initializer can immediately replace phase 2 with 1.
encounters.entry_edge: Same owned actor allocation and bounded private-data span: previous sleep 1 to current sleep 0. Do not require observing the transient level phase 2.
encounters.publication: Awake branch with actor action != 11 publishes signed actor HP and definition maximum.
encounters.caption: 0x0EA7
encounters.limits: Historical forced wake-gate setup is not natural gameplay activation evidence; HP/cache zero does not establish defeat.

encounters.owner: EeWingedDemon actors and their level controller
encounters.condition: i32 L + 0x14 == 1 and publisher actor action != 11. Updater stores the two indexed signed actor HP values at L + 0x10/+0x12 and sums nonnegative values for display.
encounters.caption: 0x10FE
encounters.limits: Do not split on either actor's mere spawn; constructor uses distinct initial actions 13/21 for record subtype 0/1. Controller activation/publication is a separate guard.

encounters.updater: 0x80010918; initial discovery export began at 0x80010920 and omits its scratch-owner load
encounters.level_controller: None: indexed descriptor declares allocation size zero and constructor 0x80010148; require the initialized null L root, not an allocated controller
encounters.private: P = u32 actor + 0x90; i32 P + 0x18 starts at zero
encounters.condition: u8 record + 0x06 == 1, i32 P + 0x18 == 1, and actor action != 11. This updater branch publishes the Captain bar.
encounters.caption: 0x11EF
encounters.limits: Initial actor construction or action 14 is not sufficient; private activation state distinguishes pre-encounter existence from publication.

verification_limits: These paths support static implementation, not a claim that all six natural entry sequences were executed.

The five publication-based conditions deliberately retain the intended legacy visible-entry timing while adding owner-specific evidence; actual asynchronous polling and bar-state lifetime remain unverified.
No boss-death, route legality, mandatory HoH visit or new category restriction is introduced.
